thread:
sam: Heads up — ACME reported a billing/attribution surprise. A project-scoped API key expired and traffic fell back to an org token; invoices show org tagging instead of project. Can we decide expected behavior?
neha: Oof. Which key path was used? project-scope only? Any logs?
sam: Project key (proj:acme-proj) with expiry==now. Traffic kept flowing ~4h. Logs: `token_fallback=org_master` and billing tags `org:acme` not `project:acme-proj`.
idan: We do have a grace window (24h) for rotated keys, but it should preserve original project attribution. Looks like attribution switch is the bug.
jordan: Two choices: preserve project attribution during grace (and mark it), or stop serving after expiry. Tradeoffs: correctness vs availability.
lina: From console/product POV, customers expect a clear 'expiring' banner + one-click rotate/extend. If behavior changes, console UX must surface it.
neha: Telemetry asks: emit `requests_during_grace{project,org,token_id}` and an event when attribution changes. Count `billing_mismatch` incidents.
idan: Quick patch idea: never switch attribution to org unless the fallback token is used explicitly. If we can't attribute to project, respond 401 after grace_end. That avoids wrong billing.
jordan: Behavior matrix proposal:
- active project token -> preserve attribution
- expired token in grace -> preserve attribution but mark usage as `grace`
- fallback to org token -> attribute to org
Also emit `grace_used=true` on traces.
sam: Sounds good. Need migration plan: change runtime config, add telemetry, update console banners, rollout canary to 10%.
neha: Console UX specifics: show "Key expires in X days" + buttons: Rotate / Extend / Enable auto-rotate. Show 'Preview billing impact' (approx cost delta). Surface 'usage_during_grace' in key detail.
idan: Implementation note + config example:
```
auth:
  expiry:
    grace_mode: preserve_attr  # options: preserve_attr | switch_to_org | reject
    grace_window_hours: 24
```
I'll add a feature flag `auth.expiry.grace_mode` and a canary route.
jordan: Watch caching (edge proxies). Add short TTL for auth decisions and a cache-bypass header when `grace_used` toggles, otherwise stale attribution will persist.
sam: I'll draft an RFC. Timeline: patch in 2 days, telemetry+console in 1 week. Ops-bot, please create canary rollout ticket.
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4321: "expiring-key-grace-preserve-attribution" assigned to @idan; canary flag enabled for 10% tomorrow 10:00 UTC :white_check_mark:
lina: I'll add console mocks and paste links here when ready.
neha: Also add alert: `billing_mismatch_rate > 0.1%` -> pager to billing-oncall.
sam: :thumbsup: thanks all — I'll track RFC and loop in billing.
